description.value: A riverside campground in Ponderosa pine and bunchgrass country where the Kettle River meets the historic Kettle Valley Railway corridor; summer tubing, canoeing, and KVR trail cycling are the main draws, with flush toilets and showers on straightforward Highway 33 access.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a 117-site camp_site operated by Quality Recreation Ltd.; the BC Parks website confirms an active recreation area 5 km north of Rock Creek on Highway 33, with the historic Kettle Valley Railway right-of-way (now Trans Canada Trail, explicitly listing cycling as a core activity) passing through the site. Reservations are confirmed by the website's prominent 'Book camping' system covering frontcountry campgrounds province-wide. A notable name discrepancy exists: OSM calls this 'Kettle Creek Campground' while BC Parks names the area 'Kettle River Recreation Area', and the OSM phone/email appear to belong to the park operator rather than BC Parks.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'Kettle Creek Campground' but BC Parks website identifies the broader area as 'Kettle River Recreation Area'; Kettle Creek may be the name of a specific campground loop within the recreation area.

OSM phone (+1-250-584-9025) appears to belong to park operator Quality Recreation Ltd. (email info@explorebcparks.ca also suggests operator, not BC Parks); BC Parks general reservation line is 1-800-689-9025. OSM phone could not be confirmed as current via website content.
OSM email (info@explorebcparks.ca) does not appear in the fetched website content and cannot be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground with 117 sites directly on the Trans Canada Trail / Kettle Valley Railway cycling corridor; a clear and useful listing for touring cyclists in the Okanagan region.

wow_evidence: historic Kettle Valley Railway right-of-way (now Trans Canada Trail, explicitly listing cycling as a core activity) passing through the site
